segments.he: בְּנֶזֶק כֵּיצַד? סִימֵּא אֶת עֵינוֹ; קָטַע אֶת יָדוֹ; שִׁיבֵּר אֶת רַגְלוֹ – רוֹאִין אוֹתוֹ כְּאִילּוּ הוּא עֶבֶד נִמְכָּר בַּשּׁוּק, וְשָׁמִין כַּמָּה הָיָה יָפֶה וְכַמָּה הוּא יָפֶה.
segments.en: «How» is payment «for damage» assessed? If «one blinded» another’s «eye, severed his hand, broke his leg,» or caused any other injury, the court «views» the injured party «as though he were a slave» being «sold in the» slave «market, and» the court «appraises how much he was worth» before the injury «and how much he is worth» after the injury. The difference between these two sums is the amount that one must pay for causing damage.

positions.claim: damage is assessed as the drop in value as a slave on the market
